findings.summary: ARQ-01, ARQ-03 and ARQ-06 are proved by the V5 step and the CI matrix, but neither names the ID and git grep traces them only to unrelated crates. Warning, not CRITICAL: all ACs are command-typed.

findings.ref: specs/02-arquitectura-software.md:76 ARQ-05; apply-progress.md Slice card IDs
findings.summary: ARQ-05 is listed as covered, but its only mechanism (cargo public-api in CI) does not exist in the repo and names three crates SC1 does not touch; the property is vacuous for two empty crates. The card's ID list is the imprecise part.
No CI job compiles the testkit ports feature, so the nine doubles (~300 lines) are outside the remote gate: run 41836317734 never compiled them. SC1 owns ci.yml, so the feature-on job belongs here.
